name: ha-shadcn-ui
description: shadcn-based UI for Home Assistant: a sidebar panel (React) + Lovelace cards (Lit), shipped as one HACS integration.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @hsu/tokens build && pnpm --filter @hsu/panel build && pnpm --filter @hsu/cards build
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
